# sig.golf beta

Sig.golf is a Lean-certified competition for stateless hash-based signatures. The score is signature bytes times maximum honest RISC-V verification cycles.

Cycle costs: 1 per instruction, 4 per multiplication or division (MUL, MULH, MULHSU, MULHU, DIV, DIVU, REM, REMU, and their W forms), 8 per HASH compression, 1 per HALT, plus ceil(W / 256) per verification for the witness. HASH needs 8-byte-aligned input and output addresses and an input length in bytes (a1) that is a multiple of 8.

Rules: /rules.html
Formal definitions: https://github.com/leanEthereum/sig.golf-dev/tree/beta
Submit by opening a PR against beta: https://github.com/leanEthereum/sig.golf-submissions/pulls
PR layout: https://github.com/leanEthereum/sig.golf-submissions/blob/beta/README.md

The claim.json file declares S, W, C, and one shared layout with six nonnegative byte offsets: message, secret_key, public_key, cache, signature, witness. All offsets are 8-byte aligned; buffers must be disjoint and fit below embedded data in every program. The submitted Lean proof must bind its layout to these exact values.

RISC-V system calls: ECALL with t0 = 0 is HASH (a0 input address, a1 length in bytes, a2 output address); any other t0 halts with exit code a0, where 0 means success (verify accepts). Invalid HASH arguments, nonzero exit codes, EBREAK, invalid instruction encodings, and memory or instruction-fetch faults fail the program (verify rejects). Invalid fetches or encodings cost zero cycles; other faults cost one cycle and make no oracle call.

Verified results are published in /records.json.

Include presentation/ beside submission/ in every PR. Copy and customize:
- /examples/presentation-template/presentation.json
- /examples/presentation-template/scheme.svg

Explain the scheme briefly and draw its signature layout, encoding, authentication, and witness expansion.

Profile N accepting runs: samples=N; instructions={mnemonic: total}, with HALT=N; hashes={input_bits: total_calls}. Describe sampling in method. Submit integer totals, not averages; the site computes per-run counts and cycles.

Each file ≤64 KiB. SVG must be static, without scripts or external resources. Displayed as “Provided by submission · not verified”; no effect on scoring.
